def: audience, i.e. the royal court; also obedience, i.e. (concretely) a subject

occurrences.text: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king’s son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?
He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.
Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
